# Reusable UI Components

#### Course: Rapid Build With Claude Code

## Reusable UI Components

SpeedBlip's src/components/ui/ folder contains six reusable components that are used across the entire app. These were built in Chunk 1 as the component foundation layer:

- Button - Primary, secondary, and ghost variants. Handles loading state with a spinner. Accepts an icon prop.
- GlassCard - The glassmorphism card container used for every dashboard panel, stat card, and settings section.
- Badge - Small status pill. Uses the brand-primary, warning, and danger tokens for color variants.
- Toggle - Boolean on/off switch. Used in Settings for notification preferences.
- Toast - Notification popup. Auto-dismisses after 3 seconds. Used for "Test complete", "Settings saved", and error messages.
- Skeleton - Loading placeholder. Pulse animation used while speed test data loads.

Having these six components ready from Chunk 1 meant every subsequent chunk could use them immediately. Claude Code never had to invent its own button styles or card containers - it imported from the existing system.

It is good practice to build your reusable component library before building any page. Pages that compose existing components are faster to build and more visually consistent than pages that create one-off components inline.
